title: Python Performance Optimization: A Practical Guide
description: Learn practical Python performance optimization techniques, from confirming a bottleneck with timeit to picking the fix that makes your program faster.
summary: Python performance optimization is the practice of making your code run faster. You find the bottleneck first, then fix only what’s slow, starting with algorithms and data structures before reaching for concurrency or C extensions.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Python Performance Optimization: A Practical Guide Test your grasp of Python performance optimization, from confirming a bottleneck with timeit to picking fixes like sets, built-ins, and caching.
You’ve written a Python script that works perfectly until you run it on real data and it crawls, or quietly consumes far more memory than it should.

Python’s built-ins and standard library often push per-item work down into C , so Counter counts faster than a handwritten loop. functools.cache stores results by argument, so it’s only safe when a function’s output depends solely on its arguments .
